text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, the Takarazuka Kinen!
A massive crowd has packed into Hanshin Racecourse!
(Eeeeek~!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Could that be—?! Amidst shrill cheers, here comes Vivlos!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, wanna do a photoshoot too~?
(Flash flash flash flash!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aha, like a celeb♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone~
Mwah mwah mwah♡"
(GYAAAAAH!? Eeeeek!)
Oh, Vivlos, what a cute greeting.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—!? Whose voice is that!?
And what's that sound above our heads!?
(Rattle rattle rattle rattle...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hellooo, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that Satono Crown--!?
The GⅠ champion of Hong Kong and Japan, Satono Crown,
descends from the sky!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry for dropping in from above.
I was doing secret special training on Satono's island until just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It was all for this day, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Bystanders
text_block_list.text:
“As expected of the Satono young ladyyy!”
“Do your very best, milady!!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll surprise you even more during the main event!
Let the magic show begin♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, things are really heating up this year too!
As expected of the Spring Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Without Kitasan here, I thought it might
end up feeling a bit lonely, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's not true! It's a really interesting group! Crown, Vivlos, plus Kiseki who's in the Senior Class this year, and—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san!
Could you give us your thoughts heading into the race?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are you running with Kitasan Black's hopes on your shoulders after all?
If you have any words from your friend...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Please allow me to convey
everything out on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that includes who—will inherit that light!
(WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAARRGHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ranked #1 in the pre-race popularity poll: Satono Diamond.
Needless to say, she has a huge fanbase,
and her aura is second to none.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But this time around,
it wouldn't be surprising no matter who wins.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
That's just how star-studded this lineup is!
I'm truly so grateful they all gathered here...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer.
Can you hear it, this surging heat...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is thrilled for what comes next!
Totally absorbed in this "Strongest Showdown Arc"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I find this whole trend, with me in it too, pretty hilarious...!"
choice_data_list: And out of everyone here, it'd be most interesting if you won.
And out of everyone here, it'd be most interesting if you won.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
The protagonist has to win today!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because this is a miraculous story!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, declaring victory already?
With us right here?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Kiseki-san.
Did you get faster since the fan appreciation festival~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Both of you!?
I was sure you had already headed to the paddock...

text_block_list.name: Crown & Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *stare.*

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. Look at me all you want, but you're not shaking my confidence!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will win. I can beat you.
All of you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's fine by me.
We'll just return the exact same words to them.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A winning boost for Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
!
...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm off!
This will surely be the finale of the "Battle for the Strongest Arc"!
choice_data_list: Win it, Kiseki! Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
(Woooooaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And I'll beat you too, Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —...Kiseki-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You are...—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—So in the end, you've decided.
That you'll be taking an extended hiatus after this year...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's okay, Dia-chan.
I'll be back someday too, and besides...’"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! There's an Umamusume
I want you to see too, Dia-chan!
That Umamusume is—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Kiseki-san!
I won't lose to you, of all people!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and chase after it! The brilliance of a diamond that reaches the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm chasing after you!
I'll chase you down and surpass you all!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's battle! Let's make it a masterpiece!
This Takarazuka Kinen—fought with you all!
